IDENT.title: Design and Implementation of a Smart, Product-Led Production Control Using Industrial Agents
IDENT.venue: IEEE Journal of Emerging and Selected Topics in Industrial Electronics

A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.value: Adopted from Wooldridge: a software agent is a computer system that can execute autonomous actions in its environment to achieve its objective.
A_DEFINITION__agent_definition_verbatim.evidence_quote: “A software agent is described as a computer system that can execute autonomous actions in its environment to achieve its objective” [5].

A_DEFINITION__definition_source.evidence_quote: A deﬁnition for these individuals, shared by many authors, comes from WOOLDRIDGE

A_DEFINITION__agent_term_used.evidence_quote: They are referred to as Industrial Agents (IAs) here

A_DEFINITION__agent_entity_types.evidence_quote: These include handling systems, processing machines, conveyors, buffers, supply and removal stations, and linear transport systems.

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_knowledge_base.evidence_quote: the PA is designed as a belief, desire and intentions (BDI) agent [18]

B_ARCHITECTURE__kb_representation.evidence_quote: provides the data structures for storing the ProductInformation coming with the request in the form of an index structure

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_mechanism.evidence_quote: the conﬁrmation is made according to the very simple ﬁrst come ﬁrst served principle

B_ARCHITECTURE__decision_scalability_dis.evidence_quote: Test runs in which the PlantConﬁg was adapted by extending it with additional resources or exchanging certain resources have shown that this can be achieved

B_ARCHITECTURE__has_communication_manage.evidence_quote: the MsgProcessor for exchanging messages and processing them

B_ARCHITECTURE__implementation_platform.evidence_quote: all implementations were carried out in the commercially offered agent framework iAgent [13]

C_MEMORY__memory_historical.evidence_quote: contains all the information about the product conﬁguration chosen by customers

C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.value: Agents configured from XML files (PlantConfig, ProductConfig, ResourceConfig); RA scheduler stores product requests.
C_MEMORY__memory_historical_description.evidence_quote: Since this AgentConﬁg class deserializes an external conﬁguration ﬁle in extensible markup language (XML) format

C_MEMORY__memory_realtime.evidence_quote: Either a change is made because of messages of an RA or the change is the result of a logical consideration of the PA itself.

C_MEMORY__memory_persists_across_episode.evidence_quote: If the order has been successfully processed, the thread of the PA is stopped.

C_MEMORY__memory_update_mechanism.evidence_quote: the transitions either result from an information or a request in the form of a message of a PA

C_MEMORY__memory_requirements_stated.evidence_quote: each of the resources must know the product conﬁgurations at the time of transport or processing

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_protocol.evidence_quote: The interactions initiated by the PA are based on the contract net protocol [22] deﬁned in the FIPA

D_COMMUNICATION__negotiation_mechanism.evidence_quote: the PA in PS SelectBestOffer selects the best offer based on the lowest ﬁctitious price

D_COMMUNICATION__comm_topology.evidence_quote: AgentManagement agent and DirectoryFacilitator agent [20], that are compliant with the Foundation for Intelligent Physical Agents (FIPA)

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__validation_level.evidence_quote: Notably, the function of the MAS has been validated as a stand-alone application.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__metrics_reported.evidence_quote: It can be seen that the expected and actual values of the PA states match.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__disruption_types_h.evidence_quote: In Scenario4, there is a delay in transport, and, therefore, product quality is compromised, which has to lead to an ejection of the product.

G_VALIDATION_METRICS__application_domain.evidence_quote: aims to build a ﬂexible, robust, and fully functional bottling plant for the production of beverages with lot size one

H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.value: Custom communication ontology built with own LanguageModel (MsgTerm/MsgContent)
H_STANDARDS__ontology_used.evidence_quote: a LanguageModel to easily build a unique ontology.

H_STANDARDS__interoperability_claimed.evidence_quote: can realize an agent communication via OPC UA using a test setup consisting of two agent containers that were distributed to an industrial PLC and a Windows PC

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_common_wi.evidence_quote: the PA always begins in the PS SearchServices with the search for RAs that offer the

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.value: Process step sequence predefined in ProductConfig rather than plan generation from a model; state-machine PlanningModule; generic ResourceTypes; custom ontology LanguageModel; commercial iAgent framework.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__features_divergent.evidence_quote: this also speciﬁes the sequence of the necessary process steps (BDI: beliefs and desires)

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.value: Ontology for communication claimed mandatory; PlanningModule mandatory core of PA.
I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__essential_componen.evidence_quote: For any comparable application, the creation of an ontology for communication within the MAS is mandatory.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__cites_reference_fr.evidence_quote: Making products intelligent was investigated and successfully implemented in [14] and [21], among others.

I_DELTA_VS_REFERENCE__static_vs_dynamic_.evidence_quote: The corresponding description of the virtual representatives of the product is read each time an order is received, starting the respective PA.
